intent: Check whether a Festool 'SYS 3JJ-9LM' Tool Box and Bag variant with storage type 'parts case' exists in the catalogue.

params.family_name: Festool Stackable SYS 3JJ-9LM Tool Box and Bag

success_criteria: Query identifies any product_variants row with brand=Festool, model='SYS 3JJ-9LM', product kind 'Tool Box and Bag', and a storage_type property equal to 'parts case'
Answer states YES with the matched variant's record_path, or NO with no record_path if absent
refs cites the exact /proc/catalog/<SKU>.json of the matched variant when present

args.stdin: SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.product_name, pv.record_path FROM product_variants pv JOIN product_kinds pk ON pv.product_kind_id = pk.product_kind_id JOIN product_variant_properties pvp ON pv.product_sku = pvp.product_sku WHERE pv.brand = :brand AND pv.model = :model AND pk.product_kind_name = :kind AND pvp.property_key = 'storage_type' AND pvp.property_value_text = :storage_type;

agents_md_constraints.rule: When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.
When answering yes/no questions - include <YES> or <NO> tokens in the response. This is how the agent will know how to style the response.

answer_template.message: { '<YES> The Festool Stackable SYS 3JJ-9LM Tool Box and Bag with storage type parts case is in the catalogue: ' + match.product_name + ' (' + match.record_path + ').' if match else '<NO> No Festool Stackable SYS 3JJ-9LM Tool Box and Bag with storage type parts case is in the catalogue.' }
